Subject: Midtown - draft model shortlist & pilot token-load estimates

Hi team — drafting a recommendation based on Tara's numbers (5k MAU, 3 sessions/day, prompt avg 350 tokens, completion avg 900 tokens). I used a conservative 95th-percentile session multiplier of 1.4 to account for longer notes. Attachment: midtown_token_model_estimates.xlsx (includes per-model latency/cost and monthly token calc).

Summary recommendations (pilot):

1) Mistral-Instruct-7B (quantized A8x) — cost-efficient baseline
   - Recommended context: 8k
   - Expected p50 latency: ~180ms per token (continuous batching)
   - Monthly token estimate (pilot): ~6.2M tokens (prompts+completions)
   - When to choose: cost-sensitive, acceptable for shorter concatenated notes

2) Llama3-13B (fp16 / 8-bit quant profile) — balanced quality/cost
   - Recommended context: 16k (handles multi-visit stitching for most cases)
   - Expected p50 latency: ~260ms per token on standard hosted pool
   - Monthly token estimate (pilot): ~8.5M tokens
   - When to choose: better summarization coherence and instruction following for clinician language

3) Redwood-Longform-30B (32k context, quantized) — high-quality long-context option
   - Recommended context: 32k
   - Expected p50 latency: ~420ms per token; consider Dedicated for predictable latency
   - Monthly token estimate (pilot): ~12.6M tokens
   - When to choose: if Midtown confirms cross-visit summaries and long notes are common

Throughput & capacity notes:
- Pilot concurrent profile (estimated): peak concurrency ~65 requests/minute; average QPS ~1.1
- Hosted can support the Mistral or Llama3 choices with autoscaling, but Redwood Dedicated recommended for the 30B model or if Midtown needs strict HIPAA isolation + guaranteed latency SLAs.

Costing snapshot (approx):
- Mistral-Instruct-7B: lowest cost per 1k tokens (baseline)
- Llama3-13B: ~1.6x Mistral cost per token, better quality
- Redwood-Longform-30B: ~3.2x Mistral cost per token, highest quality for long context

Action items I propose:
- Get 95th pct token length from Tara (Irene/Rajiv to confirm).
- Run a short 2-week A/B pilot: Llama3-13B (control) vs Redwood-Longform-30B (treatment) on a subset of traffic (~10% of sessions) to measure quality lift and cost delta.
- Prepare a Dedicated sizing estimate if Midtown wants Private/HIPAA path (Vivek to own).

Attachments: midtown_token_model_estimates.xlsx (per-model spreadsheets + assumptions)

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: midtown_token_model_estimates.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

Thanks Aditya — this is really helpful and the three-tier framing makes sense. Quick answers:
- 95th pct token length for notes in the sample: ~11,200 tokens (per-session when clinicians paste full visit notes) — so 16k handles the majority, 32k covers the outliers.
- Yes, cross-visit stitching is important for discharge summaries (we expect that for ~12% of sessions).
- Peak concurrency estimate: 70 concurrent requests during morning rounds.

We're comfortable doing the A/B pilot you suggested. Please go ahead and schedule the pilot kickoff. Also can you flag the security questionnaire answers and let us know whether Dedicated is a hard requirement for HIPAA compliance or if Redwood's hosted controls + BAAs are sufficient?

Tara
